examples.text: Предлагаю чистосердечное признание. Дадут всего восемь лет.
examples.trans: I suggest a full confession. They'll give you only eight years.

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'the most', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Мы определяем самое лучшее блюдо.
examples.trans: We determine the very best dish.

examples.text: И мы начинаем самое лучшее шоу.
examples.trans: And we are starting the very best show.

examples.text: И это, друзья, только самое начало!
examples.trans: And this, friends, is only the very beginning!

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'kind', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Добрый день, проходите к нам.
examples.trans: Good afternoon, come on over to us.

examples.text: До свидания, всего вам самого доброго.
examples.trans: Goodbye, all the very best to you.

examples.text: Добрый вечер!
examples.trans: Good evening!
